A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XVIII · the insect family

Bugs

Six insect monster girls and their other forms: the mosquito, the moth (and her caterpillar), the fairy (and the Fairy Queen), the scorpion, the bee (and her queen) and the papillon (and her caterpillar). Wings, antennae and instincts older than anything.

Favourite food: Honey and sugar (the mosquito: blood)

The central similarity

Instinct first.

Every bug girl follows her instinct: the moth flies to light, the bee to flowers and her hive, the mosquito to blood. Work with the instinct and they love you for it.

  • MetamorphosisMoths and papillons hatch as caterpillars that grow into their winged form.
  • QueensThe Fairy Queen rises from a finished fairy fountain; the Queen Bee rules a hive.
  • WingsAll but the scorpion and the caterpillars fly.
  • HoneyThe family food: honey bottles and sugar. The mosquito wants blood.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a bug builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Honey bottles (+2), sugar (+1), flowers (+1)
  • Placing beehives near a queen bee (+5)
  • A light for the moth

What costs trust

  • Swatting her
  • Breaking hives or flowers she tends

Devoted (60+)

Her instinct serves you: bees fill your hives, fairies heal you, moths light your way (Night Vision), the mosquito drains your enemies.

Mating & young

FormEggs. YoungLarvae (moth, papillon), or small daughters, grown in 5 days. WhereLeaves, hives or flowers. The caterpillars are their own small model; the others use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed (queens only).
2. EggsShe lays eggs: moths and papillons on leaves, bees in the hive, fairies in flowers.
3. LarvaeMoths and papillons hatch as caterpillars, which grow into their winged form in five days.
4. GrownThe others are born small and grow up in five days.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

BloodThe mosquito drinks blood (damage and Hunger, Weakness or Poison) and does not mind if her victim dies. Tamed, she does it to hostile mobs instead.
LightMoths fly to the brightest light nearby at night and circle it.
CaterpillarsLarvae crawl, eat leaves and grass and pick up food; after five days they become moths or papillons.
HealingFairies heal hurt players (Regeneration) and build a fairy fountain: a ring of flowers around a pool. Its water heals.
Fairy QueenOnce a fountain is finished, a Fairy Queen may rise from it: player-sized, she gives positive effects.
Hive lifeBee girls pollinate flowers, grow crops and fill beehives with honey. The Queen Bee adores players who look after hives.
ScorpionThe scorpion stings (Poison II) and carries her young on her back.

Mosquito (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentThirsty, flighty, ruthless

Ecology & behaviourA whining girl with a proboscis and thin wings. She drinks blood and does not care what happens after.

Signature: Drinks bloodHostile: drains blood (damage plus Hunger, Weakness or Poison). Calmed with honey, she drains hostile mobs for you instead.

Player interactionLet her feed on a mob instead, then feed her honey.

Hornet (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentFierce, territorial, fiercely loyal once won

Ecology & behaviourVespa (Hymenoptera: Vespidae), the largest of the social wasps. She chews wood into paper for her nest and hunts other insects, bees above all.

Signature: TerritorialShe stings players who come too close and hunts bees and bee girls until someone befriends her. On patrol she tears into hostile mobs. Friends get paper and clay.

Player interactionKeep your distance until she knows you. She eats meat and fruit. A hornet with a broken wing can't fly: mend it with a healing balm and she is yours for life.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Ant: brings loose items to her friend. Queen Ant: raises ants. Spider-Wasp: paralyses spiders
  • Mothman: at night, befriended, the monsters near her friend glow
  • Mosquito: hostile, drinks (Hunger, Weakness or Poison) until calmed with honey; then hunts your enemies
  • Moth: flies to the brightest light at night and circles it; Night Vision when devoted
  • Caterpillars eat grass, leaves and food and turn into moths and papillons after five days (keeping their bonds)
  • Fairy: heals hurt players, builds a fountain (water and eight flowers) whose water heals
  • Fairy Queen rises from a finished fountain at night and blesses friends
  • Scorpion: poison sting, carries her young
  • Bees pollinate, grow crops and fill beehives (twice as fast near a queen)
  • Queen bee: +5 for every beehive placed near her
  • Papillon plants flowers
  • Cicada: song buffs her friend
  • Dragonfly: hunts phantoms. Ladybug: Luck, ripens berries
  • Pixi: too small to share a bed; crouch and ask her and she shrinks her friend for half a minute. Rlff: her friend heals standing in water near her
  • Girtablilu: on the scorpion's rig; befriended, at night she stings the monsters near her friend
  • Date palm beetle: befriended, when her friend near her is hungry she shares a date (three hunger points)
  • Temple mantis: befriended, she cuts the tripwires of old temples and other structures near her friend before anyone trips them
  • Scarabronze: armoured; rolls rotten flesh into bone meal; at sunrise her friend gets Haste for the morning
  • Mantis: holds a prayer pose, then lunges at silverfish, endermites and spiders; the orchid mantis turns invisible among flowers
  • Firefly: glows at night, blinks in time with the others; a glass bottle catches her (or a fairy) in a jar, a light block that lets her out when opened ('Why?' advancement)

Not yet

  • Eating wool

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Caterpillars are their own species that turn into the adult species when they grow up.
  • The Fairy Queen and the caterpillars have no natural spawns.

Open questions

  • Should the moth be able to eat wool (like real moths)?
